journeys.Journey: J01 · Public company discovery and trust
journeys.Primary user roles: Public visitor, Audience/fan
journeys.Purpose: Establish VMNL identity, navigate company information, confirm authorised public claims and find human support.
journeys.Authority / source: Group Master Parts 01–03, 20–22; World R1.3C §§3–6, 9

journeys.Journey: J02 · Brand families, media identities and sub-brand discovery
journeys.Primary user roles: Public visitor, Audience/fan, Brand Steward
journeys.Purpose: Expose 35 current owner-named brands with accurate remits and independent service status, without inventing channels.
journeys.Authority / source: Group Master Parts 03–07, 11, Appendix A; Circle R2.3 §5.6; World R1.3C S18–S19

journeys.Journey: J03 · Original Storyworlds, intellectual property and Azeebo+ referral
journeys.Primary user roles: Public visitor, Audience/fan, Rights/IP officer, Azeebo+ Product (external authority)
journeys.Purpose: Present four peer storyworlds while keeping canon, title rights, media availability and Azeebo+ consumer actions separate.
journeys.Authority / source: Group Master Parts 10–13; World R1.3C S20, §§14–16

journeys.Journey: J04 · Capability, studio, academy and programme discovery
journeys.Primary user roles: Public visitor, Client contact, Applicant, Creator/talent
journeys.Purpose: Help public/professional users find the right specialist unit and route enquiries to an accountable human.
journeys.Authority / source: Group Master Parts 08–09, 14–16; World R1.3C S02, S03

journeys.Journey: J05 · Public enquiries, qualified intake and application handoff
journeys.Primary user roles: Public visitor, Client contact, Partner, Commercial/BD
journeys.Purpose: Capture the correct request once, preserve privacy, and make a real receiving owner accountable for follow-up.
journeys.Authority / source: World R1.3C S04, §§5–7; Circle COM-01–04

journeys.Journey: J06 · Identity, onboarding, consent and relationship switching
journeys.Primary user roles: Employee/contractor, Client contact, Creator/talent, Learner, Partner
journeys.Purpose: Authenticate separately verified relationships and enforce purpose-bound access without merging consumer and employee accounts.

journeys.Journey: J07 · Client onboarding, commissioning, delivery and acceptance
journeys.Primary user roles: Client contact, Commercial/BD, Mission Owner, Producer/ONE Studios
journeys.Purpose: Move a qualified client brief to signed scope, accepted delivery, invoices and verifiable next work.
journeys.Authority / source: Group Master Parts 15–17; Circle COM/FIN/VCF/ONE SOPs; World R1.3C J01, S05–S08

journeys.Journey: J08 · Sponsors, institutional partners, training providers and organisations
journeys.Primary user roles: Partner, Sponsor, Training partner, Commercial/BD, Talent Accelerator operator
journeys.Purpose: Onboard external organisations under verified legal identity, sponsorship conditions, IP and access boundaries.
journeys.Authority / source: Group Master Parts 09, 14, 16–17; Circle partnership/Accelerator; World R1.3C S09

journeys.Journey: J09 · Accelerator applications, AFCA learning and CLAP progression
journeys.Primary user roles: Applicant, Learner, AFCA academic authority, Talent Accelerator operator, Training partner
journeys.Purpose: Separate admissions, teaching, assessments, moderation, appeals, verification and downstream professional work.
journeys.Authority / source: Group Master Part 09 Appendices B–C; Circle ACC/AFC and Register S; World R1.3C S27

journeys.Journey: J10 · Creator onboarding, professional marketplace and paid work
journeys.Primary user roles: Creator/talent, VTM Marketplace operator, VCF creator operator, Client contact
journeys.Purpose: Support evidence-backed profile verification, qualified work, consent, acceptance, settlement and disputes.
journeys.Authority / source: Group Master Part 08; Circle VTM/VCF SOPs; World R1.3C S10, S27

journeys.Journey: J11 · Candy Cast, Candy Plus and restricted-consent boundaries
journeys.Primary user roles: Candy Cast applicant, Public visitor, Brand Steward, Privacy officer, Legal counsel
journeys.Purpose: Protect adult casting participation, independent decisions and separate subscription/product controls.
journeys.Authority / source: Group Master Part 06, 20; Circle R2.3 §5.8; World R1.3C S28–S29

journeys.Journey: J12 · ONE CIRCLE home, knowledge, SOP discovery and Ask VMN
journeys.Primary user roles: Employee/contractor, Builder, Problem Solver, Coach/mentor, Knowledge steward
journeys.Purpose: Give each authorised worker one reliable entry to current procedures, missions and owner-backed knowledge without universal private access.
journeys.Authority / source: Circle R2.3 §§1–12,16, App S/T; World R1.3C S06, S11, S22–S24

journeys.Journey: J13 · Mission framing, staffing, execution, approvals and closure
journeys.Primary user roles: Mission Owner, Builder, Problem Solver, Coach/mentor, Hub resource coordinator
journeys.Purpose: Move an actual task from intake through signed gates, accepted deliverable, source reconciliation and reusable learning.
journeys.Authority / source: Circle R2.3 §§4,6–10, Appendix N; World R1.3C §11 and S07–S08, S21

journeys.Journey: J14 · Capability leaders, resource management and coaching
journeys.Primary user roles: Capability Lead, Coach/mentor, Hub resource coordinator, People & Culture
journeys.Purpose: Prevent double booking, protect employment responsibility, and track professional quality without converting Coach mode into HR authority.
journeys.Authority / source: Circle R2.3 §§6–8,13,17; World R1.3C capability/capacity screens

journeys.Journey: J15 · ONE Studios, VCF production and professional asset delivery
journeys.Primary user roles: Producer/ONE Studios, VCF creator operator, Builder, Editor/publisher
journeys.Purpose: Support professional work while preserving actual media ownership, production permissions, asset/version QC and handoff.
journeys.Authority / source: Group Master Part 08, 13; Circle ONE/VCF SOPs; World R1.3C professional portals

journeys.Journey: J16 · Fusion Events, 9TLIFE, Azeebo+ Live and event operations
journeys.Primary user roles: Fusion Events operator, Venue/vendor, Client contact, Producer/ONE Studios
journeys.Purpose: Support event and city-experience workflows while keeping Azeebo+ Live transactions and third-party fulfilment independent.
journeys.Authority / source: Group Master Parts 11,14–15; Circle FUS SOPs; World R1.3C live and lifestyle boundaries

journeys.Journey: J17 · IP, storyworld governance, rights and TEND licensing
journeys.Primary user roles: Rights holder, Rights/IP officer, TEND licensing officer, Distributor/buyer, Producer/ONE Studios
journeys.Purpose: Manage title rights and external opportunities without assuming ownership from a script, media file or Originals label.
journeys.Authority / source: Group Master Parts 13,16,20; Circle IPR/TND/LEG SOPs; World R1.3C S25

journeys.Journey: J18 · Brand editorial, publishing, media and company content governance
journeys.Primary user roles: Editor/publisher, Brand Steward, Marketing/PR, Producer/ONE Studios
journeys.Purpose: Publish verified brand/content copy with legal, rights, advertising and service-status controls.
journeys.Authority / source: Group Master Parts 04–07,20,22; Circle KNW/MED/BRC SOPs; World R1.3C S26

journeys.Journey: J19 · Broadcast scheduling, traffic, transmission and proof-of-air
journeys.Primary user roles: Broadcast operator, Traffic/scheduling controller, Master control engineer, Rights/IP officer, Finance/controller
journeys.Purpose: Keep actual channel IDs and rights-safe schedule/EPG/playlist/as-run evidence distinct.
journeys.Authority / source: Group Master Part 07; R1.2A C02,C04,C06; Circle BRC/BPT; World R1.3C §§14–15

journeys.Journey: J20 · Finance, commercial performance, treasury and capital controls
journeys.Primary user roles: Finance/controller, CFO/treasury approver, Commercial/BD, Executive/Board adviser
journeys.Purpose: Expose source-backed obligations and approvals without replacing the general ledger or treating proposed cash as available.
journeys.Authority / source: Finance Master R1.1 FINP-01–22; Group Master Part 17; Circle finance; World R1.3C S30

journeys.Journey: J21 · Legal, People, governance, privacy and formal approvals
journeys.Primary user roles: Legal counsel, People & Culture, Privacy officer, Executive/Board adviser, Independent auditor/QA
journeys.Purpose: Make reserved authorities and protected personal rights operable without letting missions or AI make legal or employment decisions.
journeys.Authority / source: Legal Master R1.1 LEG-01–24; Circle People/Legal/Executives; World R1.3C S12, S15

journeys.Journey: J22 · AI, Cr8Tech, system integrations, product operations and security
journeys.Primary user roles: AI/AgentOps owner, Cr8Tech/engineering, Security/IT administrator, Platform tenant administrator, Knowledge steward, VMN World Product/QA
journeys.Purpose: Operate controlled source, agent and product release governance without pretending unverified connectors are live.
journeys.Authority / source: Circle R2.3 Appendices S–U; World R1.3C §§12–14,17,20 and Appendix N

journeys.Journey: J23 · Global edge cases, denial, outage, recovery and safety states
journeys.Primary user roles: Public visitor, Employee/contractor, Customer/support operator, VMN World Product/QA
journeys.Purpose: Reusable system-wide pages/modals for predictable failures, truthful status and accessible recovery.
journeys.Authority / source: World R1.3C §§9,11–12,17–22; Circle incident and source procedures
